build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: A slot machine grid (at least 3x5) spins each turn and lands symbols in random positions. Symbols activate and generate coins based on their effects and adjacency to other symbols. The spin is visually animated. Score 0 if no slot spin mechanic exists.

Symbols interact with adjacent symbols — specific combinations multiply value, trigger effects, or transform neighbors. At least 3 distinct interaction types exist (multiply, destroy, transform). Score 0 if symbols are independent with no interactions.

Between spins, a shop offers new symbols to add to the reel pool and an option to remove existing symbols for a fee. The player curates their symbol pool strategically. Score 0 if no symbol management exists.

Rent is due every few spins (e.g., every 5) and escalates each cycle. If the player cannot pay rent, the run ends. The rent amount and deadline are always visible. Score 0 if no rent or loss condition exists.
A coin counter tallies earnings per spin with visible per-symbol payouts. The total coin balance persists between spins and is spent on rent and shop purchases. Score 0 if no economy exists.

At least 15 distinct symbol types exist across rarity tiers (common, rare, legendary) with different base values and interaction effects. Rare symbols have more powerful or unique interactions. Score 0 if fewer than 8 symbol types exist.

Symbol synergies create emergent strategies — certain symbol combinations produce exponential value when built around (e.g., a symbol that doubles all adjacent fruit symbols). At least 3 distinct buildable synergy paths exist. Score 0 if no synergies exist.

The shop offers different symbols each cycle with increasing rarity available in later cycles. Shop selection is randomized, creating different strategic options each run. Score 0 if the shop always offers the same symbols.

Rent escalation creates meaningful difficulty curve — early cycles are forgiving, later cycles demand optimized symbol engines. The escalation rate is visible and predictable. Score 0 if rent is flat throughout.
A game-over screen shows spins survived, peak coins in a single spin, total coins earned, rent cycles completed, and best symbol combo. Score 0 if no results exist.
A styled title screen shows a slot machine with glowing symbols and the game name. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> spin -> payout display -> shop -> rent check -> next spin or game over without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.

During gameplay, coin balance, rent amount, spins until rent, and symbol pool contents are visible. Per-symbol payouts are shown after each spin with clear attribution. Score 0 if no economy display exists.

Readability at 1280x720 is strong: all symbol types are visually distinct, interactions are shown with connecting lines or highlights, and the grid is clearly organized. Score 0 if symbols are indistinguishable.

The art direction is coherent across title, slot grid, symbols, shop, and UI — a consistent casino/luck aesthetic with vibrant palette and unified visual language. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Symbols use real illustrated icons with distinct silhouettes and colors — not plain text labels or colored squares. The slot machine frame and grid have polished visual treatment. Score 0 if symbols are text or plain shapes.

HUD and UI chrome: coin display, rent indicator, shop interface, payout breakdown, and game-over screen use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: reels spin with smooth animation, symbols pulse when activating, coin payouts cascade with particle effects, interactions show connecting visual lines, and rent payment has a dramatic moment. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
